bio: Take the express lift 23 floors high to Cloud 23 for Afternoon Tea in the sky.  Floor-to-ceiling windows offer jaw-dropping views across a constantly changing cityscape. With its warm, contemporary design and stylish soundtrack, Cloud 23 bar creates an atmosphere for Afternoon Tea like no other.  Afternoon Tea overlooking the Manchester skyline is available daily. Enjoy a Cocktail, Mocktail or glass of Champagne alongside your Afternoon Tea for a special treat!  Children's Afternoon Tea is also available, priced at £15 per child under 12 years.  Reservations are essential.
